chunks.text: What Are TrueMark Objects? — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint What Are TrueMark Objects? TrueMark Objects are structured digital artifacts that represent verified knowledge, intellectual work, or meaningful historical records. Instead of being simple files or speculative tokens, a TrueMark Object combines several elements into a durable digital record. • The original artifact (document, knowledge, media, etc.) • A forensic certificate verifying its origin • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata Together these elements transform ordinary information into a verified digital object with a permanent record of origin. Why TrueMark Objects Exist Most knowledge today lives in fragile places: > PDFs that disappear > Cloud folders that get lost > Platforms that shut down > Research that loses attribution > Family knowledge that dies with a generation TrueMark Objects were created to solve this problem. They turn important knowledge into durable digital assets that can be preserved, verified, and transferred over time. Types of TrueMark Objects TrueMark uses several object types depending on the nature of the knowledge being preserved. K-NFT Knowledge Object A single artifact such as a book, document, research paper, or instructional guide. KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A structured set of knowledge designed for licensing, such as courses, masterclasses, or training programs. H-NFT Heirloom Object Family knowledge intended to be passed down across generations, such as recipes, traditions, or historical records. L-NFT Legacy Object Major intellectual contributions or lifetime works preserved for long-term historical value. E-NFT Enterprise Object Organizational artifacts such as research records, technical documentation, or certified institutional data. What Makes Them Valuable TrueMark Objects can support multiple forms of use and transfer. Depending on the creator's intent, an object may be: Sold Licensed Transferred Collected Inherited The value comes from the knowledge or artifact itself , while TrueMark provides the structure that preserves its authenticity and history. In Simple Terms A TrueMark Object turns knowledge into something that can be: Preserved Verified Owned Licensed or passed down to future generations. © 2026 spruked . Truth with teeth. At its core, Spruked develops tools that allow individuals, professionals, and organizations to capture what they know, prove when it existed, and preserve it in a verifiable form . The modern world produces an overwhelming amount of information, but very little of it is structured, authenticated, or preserved in a meaningful way . Spruked exists to change that. Through a growing ecosystem of technologies — including CertSig™, TrueMark™, GOAT, and the Pro Prime Series AI systems — Spruked builds infrastructure that transforms knowledge into a durable digital asset. If knowledge has value, it deserves to be preserved properly. The Philosophy Spruked is built on a simple belief: "If better is possible, good is never enough." Most software is built to solve immediate problems. Spruked focuses on building systems that still make sense decades from now. The design philosophy emphasizes: Clarity over complexity Verification over assumption Permanence over convenience Discipline over novelty This approach guides every system within the Spruked ecosystem. What Spruked Builds Spruked develops several interconnected systems designed to support the preservation and verification of knowledge and digital artifacts. Key components include: CertSig™ A forensic-grade certificate system designed to produce verifiable digital records with layered authentication and metadata. CertSig allows documents, knowledge artifacts, and creative works to be issued with structured verification layers and optional blockchain anchoring. TrueMark™ A minting and verification framework that allows knowledge, intellectual property, and expertise to be issued as structured digital assets . The goal is not speculation or hype — but preservation and attribution. GOAT The GOAT system prepares and organizes digital artifacts before they are issued or archived. It acts as the preparation layer that ensures artifacts are structured, documented, and ready for long-term preservation. Pro Prime Series AI The Pro Prime Series explores the future of ethical, verifiable AI cognition systems . These systems focus on transparency, traceability, and philosophical grounding rather than opaque automation. Architecture draws inspiration from classical philosophy: Locke, Hume, Kant, and Spinoza. Why It Exists The internet solved distribution. It did not solve authenticity, permanence, or ownership of knowledge . Ideas disappear. Expertise is lost. Proof of authorship fades. Spruked exists to build the infrastructure that prevents that. The Founder My name is Bryan Spruk . I am a builder, salesman, systems thinker, and founder of the Pro Prime Series AI ecosystem. My professional background is not traditional. I did not come through a university program, venture studio, or corporate engineering track. I came through work: automotive sales, business development, welding, machining, entrepreneurship, customer service, and years of solving problems with limited resources. That background shaped the way I build. I tend to think in systems, structures, workflows, and practical outcomes. I am not interested in technology for show. I am interested in tools that help real people preserve knowledge, operate better, protect privacy, and turn difficult work into something usable. The projects I am building, including ORBS, GOAT, True Mark, CertSig, and related Pro Prime systems , come from that same place. They care about: Immutable internal records Forensic timestamping Digital twin infrastructure Verifiable intellectual property Sovereign data control Alpha CertSig was built for this new reality. Unlike speculative NFTs, TrueMark objects represent real intellectual artifacts that can be preserved, licensed, transferred, or inherited over time. Each NFT type exists to serve a different purpose in the preservation of knowledge and digital legacy. K-NFT Knowledge Object KL-NFT Licensed Knowledge H-NFT Heirloom Object L-NFT Legacy Object E-NFT Enterprise Object K-NFT Knowledge Object A K-NFT represents a single intellectual artifact or a tightly related set of artifacts. These objects preserve a specific piece of knowledge in a durable digital format. Examples A single book or manuscript A research paper A technical document An engineering method A proprietary process An instructional guide A creative work Value Model A K-NFT can be: Sold to another party Licensed for use or distribution Transferred to institutions or collectors In many cases, a K-NFT functions like a digital edition of an intellectual artifact , preserved with permanent authorship and timestamp verification. Certificate Representation KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A KL-NFT represents a structured collection of knowledge artifacts designed for licensing and distribution. Where a K-NFT represents a single artifact, a KL-NFT represents a complete knowledge system. Examples Professional training courses Masterclass programs Structured learning systems Educational curriculum Research collections Multi-part technical instruction Value Model KL-NFTs are designed to be licensed repeatedly . Owners may: License access to the content Distribute learning programs Offer certification or training based on the material This makes KL-NFTs ideal for educators, subject-matter experts, and organizations that want to preserve and distribute structured expertise. H-NFT Heirloom Object An H-NFT preserves knowledge and artifacts intended to be passed down across generations. These objects focus on family legacy and cultural preservation. Examples Family recipes Letters to future generations Historical family documents Farming knowledge passed through generations Craftsmanship techniques Cultural traditions These artifacts may contain knowledge that has been preserved within families for decades or even centuries. Value Model Heirloom NFTs may be: Inherited across generations Preserved as family archives Licensed if the knowledge becomes valuable to others The primary goal of an H-NFT is preservation and continuity of family knowledge. L-NFT Legacy Object An L-NFT represents significant intellectual contributions or life-work artifacts. These objects often preserve work that has long-term historical or intellectual importance. Examples Major discoveries Important technical designs Lifetime research collections Influential creative works Historical documentation Legacy NFTs preserve the long-term intellectual footprint of a creator or organization. Value Model Legacy objects may be: Transferred to archives or institutions Preserved as historical records Licensed for educational or research use These artifacts are often created to ensure that meaningful contributions are not lost over time. E-NFT Enterprise Object An E-NFT represents digital objects created by organizations or institutions. These objects often originate from systems such as Alpha CertSig infrastructure and may represent internal or external artifacts.
